learning_objective: 🎯 Analyze the crushing weight of societal expectations and the tragedy of maintaining a false facade of wealth in this emotionally gripping story.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Satyajit was once a highly successful, self-made rich man in the city. However, his bank collapsed, leaving him completely bankrupt. He hides this humiliating truth from everyone, including his wife.

He travels to his ancestral village to attend the wedding of Srinath's daughter. In the village, everyone still believes Satyajit is a millionaire. They treat him like royalty, and he enjoys the attention, unable to confess his poverty.

Disaster strikes when the groom's family demands an extra cash dowry. Srinath begs Satyajit for a loan to save the wedding. Trapped by his own false prestige, Satyajit secretly gives away his wife's diamond ring—his absolute last piece of wealth—to maintain the illusion.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 The Mask of Success
fun_activity.instructions: Satyajit ruined himself just to look successful. Think about social media today (like Instagram). People often post only their best moments to look successful, hiding their struggles. Write down one way social media forces people to wear a 'mask' like Satyajit!

exam_tips: 📌 Title significance: 'Glory at Twilight' means that Satyajit gets a final, fleeting moment of respect and glory right before his life plunges into total darkness (bankruptcy).
📌 Theme of Dowry: The story subtly critiques the brutal dowry system that forces fathers like Srinath to beg, and traps men like Satyajit.
📌 Character flaw: Satyajit's fatal flaw is his pride. He would rather lose his wife's last security than admit he is no longer rich.
quick_recap: ⭐ Satyajit loses all his wealth in a bank collapse but keeps it a secret.
⭐ He attends a village wedding where people still treat him as a wealthy savior.
⭐ To maintain his fake reputation, he sacrifices his very last asset to pay the bride's dowry.
